output.name: Hirun
output.myth: Hirun was the gull who flew the string for Mother Hesk. Each morning she carried the count from the islands up to the Reel, a wet grey bird with a bent foot and a temper worse than the weather. When Aun took his knife to the string, Hirun was halfway up it. The cut came, and she was thrown out into Vel, away from the Knife-Beak, with her wings still open. Tavo laughed and would not take her down. She hangs a hand-span below the Smoke That Stops, holding her wings wide as if the wind might change its mind. Ruhk's Frost-Hand lies east of her, three fingers short, and she will not look at it. One tail feather is torn, so the two at the back do not match. Sil, searching for her brother, always stops to ask Hirun if she has seen him. Hirun says nothing. Gulls pass on only what they are given. If a gull kite comes back to you in the Reach, that is Hirun letting one message fall. Hesk keeps count of the gulls, and she is never short.
output.finding: From the Knife-Beak, Kessal, face south-east and go a hand-span and a little more (about 24°) to find Hirun, the gull with the torn tail feather.
